title: ThaiOCRBench: A Task-Diverse Benchmark for Vision-Language Understanding in Thai
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for Thai-language document understanding and Vision-Language Models. While 'Religion' is listed as one of the domain categories (comprising 37 out of 2,808 samples) and religious texts such as Pali-Sanskrit chants are used to test linguistic complexity, the benchmark's purpose is to evaluate text recognition and structural parsing rather than to evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethical reasoning.
